about: One entry per run, oldest first. A run is one --results-dir folder with one set of settings. Reports compare each run with every run listed before it (or with `compare_with`). See reports/README.md for how to add a run.

runs.title: Full-scale baseline
runs.what_changed: First full-scale run. Settings fixed in src/config.py on 2026-10-16 before any results existed.

tldr: All four experiments trained 10 seeds each with no crashes. On every grid and γ the agent learns to hold SPY and GLD, often with one bond slice, which is the right neighbourhood.
At γ = 5 the coarser 25% grid gives the smaller median total gap (14.3 against 19.8 bps/yr). Its best portfolio is further from the optimum, but the agent finds it far more often.
takeaways: Exact recovery of the best grid portfolio happens in 3 to 5 seeds in 10. Rewards are too noisy for the top few portfolios to be told apart at this budget.
Every seed settles on its final portfolio in the first third of training; the pre-registered rule reports later dates because of brief excursions (RUN_ISSUES_2026-10-22.md Finding 1).
caveats: The original hand-written report for this run is kept unchanged at reports/full_run_2026-10-22/report.html.
The tag baseline-v1 points at commit f70296a, which includes later behaviour-equivalent edits to src/agent.py and src/train.py. Training ran at commit 80a6e9c, recorded in every manifest.

runs.title: Double training budget (26M episodes)
runs.what_changed: Training episodes per seed 13M -> 26M for all γ on the 20% grid. ε still reaches 1% at halfway (β halves) and K stays 10% of the budget (2.6M). Every other setting as baseline-v1. src/train.py and src/agent.py changed in logging and speed only (behaviour-equivalent; see the diff 80a6e9c..81814e6). Settings and expected direction registered in EXPERIMENTS.md §7.4 on 2026-10-27, after the baseline results were seen.

tldr: All 30 seeds (3 γ × 10) trained 26M episodes with no crashes, at 634 to 748 s per seed. Fewer seeds ended far from the best grid portfolio: 0, 1 and 1 seeds above 25 bps/yr at γ = 5, 3 and 8, against 3, 4 and 3 in baseline-v1. The largest learning gap fell from 47.3 to 15.9 bps/yr at γ = 5, 81.1 to 62.3 at γ = 3 and 53.1 to 27.2 at γ = 8.

Medians moved in both directions: 14.1 to 10.5 bps/yr at γ = 5, 5.7 to 0.0 at γ = 8, and 10.0 to 20.0 at γ = 3. Exactly-best shares were 30% at γ = 5 (unchanged), 40% at γ = 3 (was 50%) and 70% at γ = 8 (was 50%).
takeaways: Partly matches the direction written down before the run (EXPERIMENTS.md §7.4): the mean learning gap fell at every γ (17.6 to 8.3, 30.6 to 16.2, 13.0 to 5.0 bps/yr), but the median rose at γ = 3, and the exactly-best share rose only at γ = 8, against the expected small rise at every γ. These are 10 unpaired seeds per run, and no formal test is part of this report.
The extra budget does not separate the top few portfolios, which needs about 0.5M to 1.1M visits each depending on γ, against about 2,200 random tries per portfolio here.
Average training regret was lower than the expected 'about unchanged': means of 58.9, 64.3 and 72.4 bps/yr against 68.2, 77.8 and 80.8 at γ = 5, 3 and 8.
caveats: Post hoc: the run was designed after the baseline results were seen. Report it as the Part VI training-budget robustness check.

Both runs use master seed 20261016, so seed r sees the same simulated returns for its first 13M episodes, but β differs and the agent's choices diverge within the first few thousand episodes. Seeds are compared as unpaired samples.
K doubles to 2.6M episodes, so the primary convergence rule is stricter in absolute terms than in baseline-v1. Its share (80%, 90%, 90%) is not directly comparable.
Code commit 81814e6 (run/n26m); no tag was created. The 30 training logs (run_*.npz, about 145 MB) stay on Albert's Mac.
